intent_en: To illustrate the rapid and massive increase in confirmed Covid-19 deaths over a single year.
previous_intent: To illustrate the rapid and massive increase in confirmed global deaths from Covid-19 over the course of the first year of the pandemic.
narration_support: In one year, this virus killed over 2 million people worldwide.
chart_support: Line chart showing the cumulative trend of confirmed deaths from Covid-19 rising steadily from March 2020 to March 2021.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly mentions a one-year timeframe and a high death toll, while the chart visualizes the cumulative growth of deaths over exactly that period (March 2020 to March 2021), reaching the upper limit of the axis.
